line: - **write-product-log** Write the product log from the template; for an old project, from README, issues, plans, leaving history to version control.
note: The sentence 'what cannot be written yet follows the blank-page rule' is the blank-page line. overview#1 keeps the one-product-log rule.

line: - **blank-page** If the product cannot be written yet, start from a design and let its conclusions fill the log. Read details/product-log.md first.
note: Long file: the six-row table (design log to product log), the IDEO methods alone not being enough, the stakeholder table written first because a design uses role cards from its first stage.

line: - **facts-then-questions** [sm] *Supplement.* Look up facts yourself; ask the PO in one numbered message, each with a recommended answer.
note: Kept with its Supplement label: inferred by the assistant, never confirmed in practice. The PO decides whether it stays.

line: - **product-log-header** Product statement (1.1) and Product Goal (1.2): one-row commitment tables; no Now or Waiting for PO line (other logs only).
note: The optional vision line is dropped from the list (the template has it).

lines: - **dod-in-product-log** Keep the full Definition of Done in 1.3; a Sprint picks where to focus checks, never which standards apply.
- **dod-standards** Write standards precisely; keep only what holds across the product; item-specific or tentative ones go in acceptance criteria.
where_else: The two definitions (Outcome Done, Output Done) are in plugins/ideo-scrum/skills/scrum-kernel/references/scrum-artifact-increment.md.

line: - **stakeholder-table** List stakeholders in 2.1 in a short table; a Stakeholder subagent gets one row, the AI fills in details; if empty, ask the PO.
- **architecture-map** Open 2.2 with a Mermaid flowchart TD map: actors (AI too) on top, ending at the bottom, 5-15 steps; subsections only if needed.
note: The verifier found that steps/2-1 draws actors on the left and the ending on the right, so this line cannot just point there. 'Add a subsection only for a step that needs more words' is dropped as detail.

line: - **no-tbd** Turn an unclear point into an item; a Sprint or a design works it out.
- **no-technical-design** Keep technical design out of the product log; modules and interfaces live in the Increment.
- **item-columns** An item has seven columns: #, Title, User story, Place, Status, Size, Notes. Read details/product-log.md first.
note: The table is kept word for word in the long file: the template has only the column names.

line: - **numbers-not-ranks** Number items only to count them, every number unique; the PO ranks when an order is needed.
- **items-with-sm** The PO decides items with the Scrum Master; Scrum Master and Developer flag too much or little. Read details/product-log.md first.
note: A departure from the Scrum Guide (the Developers select the items); the departure is in the departures long file. The check when the rows are written is the sprint line select-items.

line: - **status-lives-here** An item's status lives in the product log only; a sprint log names items by number.
- **refine-in-sprint** In the product log only add detail (it has no refinement section); finish refinement in the sprint log's 2.2.
note: Low confidence in the annotation: part of the original is signposting.

line: - **acceptance-written-once** Acceptance criteria already in the product log are not repeated in the sprint log.
where_else: The seven steps themselves are in the refinement long file.

line: - **where-refined-content** Splits become rows; long design in 2.2 (Place links it); notes in Notes; big files in scrum/documents/, linked in Notes.
- **fresh-at-review** At each Review move done items to 3.2 with source, unfinished to 3.1; delete outdated text. Read details/closing.md first.
note: 'Fresh means more than the items: the Review keeps the rest of scrum/ fresh too' goes with the Review rule in the sprint-closing long file.

line: - **product-log-changes** Write item changes in Notes; a Product Goal change goes in 1.2 with date and reason, and needs evidence against the old one.
note: overview#17 covers 'only the PO changes a commitment'; this line adds where the changes are written and the evidence condition.
